title: Real-time map of Great Britain's rail network
summary: A real-time visualization map displaying Great Britain's rail network with live train locations and status updates, built using open data from National Rail's Darwin API.
problem_solved: Provides real-time visibility into GB rail network operations, helping passengers and enthusiasts track train movements across the country.
why_valuable: Transforms complex rail data into an intuitive visual format, improving transparency and passenger information accessibility.
